common_trajectory: all candidates retained / no pruning; existing actual native tau0 traces from all 9 frozen models, joined one-to-one with validated baseline expansion records
population: primary: cache-miss candidates actually scored by all models; cache-hit candidates recorded but protected and excluded from ranking/intervention primary sample
pairing: all unordered pairs of noncached candidates within same (query_id, beam_step); never cross-query pairs; no outcome-based pair selection
natural_exact: all 11 Global columns bit-identical; if empty report no support / NA rather than invent exact-state pairs
natural_near: same real beam; require all Global dimensions except unexpanded_count bit-identical; normalized Global L2 <= locked maximum of 3 / training std(unexpanded_count) + tolerance
canonical_control: use observed state from beam selection position0 as common Global vector; retain each candidate six original Candidate features; rescore frozen models only; not an actually deployed search or new training; slight canonical-input distribution shift disclosed

contribution_targets.admitted_neighbors: number of actually admitted neighbors during original expansion, observed direct marginal contribution in original processing order; not causal necessity
contribution_targets.conservative_retain: admitted>0 or node in baseline final Top10; not proof of necessity
contribution_targets.lost_hits: baseline Top10 GT hits minus hits after exactly one forced Skip at this candidate; subsequent graph search completes normally

counterfactual: exhaustive single-node intervention for every cache-miss baseline candidate; baseline model tau=0 (all retained), force score=-1 exactly once before decision; byte-identical original node, 17D pre-I/O state and native passive score checked; no reuse of E4-1 labels from a different pruned trajectory
intervention_model: Full17 seed42 used only as passive tau0 score carrier; thresholds disabled, so all three groups share identical original search path
sham: 1000 fixed random cache-miss Keep->Keep interventions; same final IDs, distances, reads, expansions, neighbor comparisons required
metrics: graded Pairwise Accuracy on unequal contribution counts; within-beam binary conditional AUC on positive/negative pairs (equal to tie-adjusted pairwise accuracy on those pairs); score ties count 0.5, target ties excluded with support reported; query/beam macro metrics additionally saved
confidence: 1000 target-query cluster bootstrap draws, jointly resampling the three matched training seeds for group summaries and differences; individual pairs not treated independent
limitations: Previously observed test set; exploratory diagnostic
Same-beam direct admission contributions depend on original processing order and overlapping neighborhoods
Single-node causal marginal labels cannot be summed as joint pruning effects
Canonical Global-only ties are a construction sanity check, not independent evidence against Global-only
Pairwise Accuracy / conditional AUC do not establish end-to-end Recall/latency gains
